svg.title: Rec-engine personal data model across four systems
svg.desc: Engine, Plugin, and Smaily hold rec-engine personal data; WooCommerce is out of scope. Export omits attribution, erase deletes everything, opt-out is governed by Smaily profiling consent.
svg.text: exports its own meta — not Woo data
plugin writes it, reads it back
Woo's own GDPR tooling handles these
